column1: # Holidays fixed by law, every year: rule, kind, places, name, law. Rule MM-DD, or MM-last-Mon for
# the last Monday of the month. Kind S special non-working day (a day off there), W special working
# holiday (not a day off). Places: empty for the whole country, else Province or Province/Town as
# named in towns.tsv, several separated by ";". Read by build_holidays.py, which gives each rule a
# date in every year of the list and leaves a year's date out where that year's proclamations
# already hold a day for the same place within a week (the proclamation moved or replaced it).
# From the Republic Act titles on lawphil.net (indexes 1946 to 4 Sep 2026, read 2026-11-18);
# the texts of RA 12099, 9210 and 7552 were read as well. Left out on purpose: RA 7281 (Abra,
# 10 March: RA 7682 and RA 10774 give 9 March), RA 9089 (Naga, 15 December: repealed by RA 9210),
# RA 7672 (Benguet, 18 June: repealed by RA 12099), RA 9427 (Biñan, 5 February: RA 11442 gives
# 3 February), RA 9118 (Muntinlupa: RA 9191 made the day non-working), RA 9031 (Camarines Sur:
# RA 9410 made the day non-working), RA 9071 (Occidental Mindoro, 13 June: RA 11123 gives
# 15 November), RA 6721 (Pangasinan, 13 November: no reason or kind given), RA 11443 (Bulacan,
# 23 January: the same day is a national working holiday by RA 11014).
